flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4101 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.
Get the reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.

r = network.requests(path="/")[0]
m = re.search(r'Done!\s*Ref\s+([A-Z]+-\d+)', r.response_body)
return m.group(1) if m else None
